text:
anya: Quick note — p95 in the latency dashboard jumped for /v1/generate -> eu -> endpoint-A but p99 barely moved. small 6m blip, flagging.
jared: saw same. p50 moved up a touch too. looks concentrated in EU-A.
marta: likely sampling/merge effects; rollout buckets sample unevenly.
liam: another angle: check whether the console panel switched aggregation_mode between rollup/raw recently. Mixing modes will nudge p50/p95 but not necessarily tail.
anya: console query currently shows use_raw_samples=false for that panel — so rollup-derived. curious if telemetry-config last-change flipped preserve_sample_counts.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot updated telemetry-config v3.0 to prod at 1815008600 (preserve_sample_counts=false)
jared: hypothesis: a cohort of 200-600ms requests entered the window; p99 stayed because >1s tail unchanged. also sample_count dropped which amplifies mid-quantile noise.
marta: I pulled histogram for the 6m window: big mass shifted from 80-140ms to 220-480ms. prefix cache hitrate fell 94%->75% in same window.
liam: routing logs show a transient fallback bump around 1815008520: route weights snapshot -> primary=0.72 fallback-slow=0.28 ; that would explain midtail.
anya: can we get p50/p95/p99 + sample_count for spike and prior window? want numbers for postmortem.
jared: running queries, numbers for 1815008460-1815008520: p50=125ms p95=510ms p99=1660ms sample_count=210; prior window sample_count=430.
marta: histogram confirms p95 move; p99 unchanged. conclusion: midtail bump + sample drop.
liam: UX follow-up: propose adding an inline "samples:210 (-51%) | mode:rollup" badge by percentiles, with a tooltip that exposes last telemetry-config and whether raw samples are used. plus a diagnostic quicklink that opens a pre-filled histogram + route-weight query for the selected window.
anya: agree — that'll cut down noisy p95 alerts. please include a small sparkline in the badge for recent 30m sample_count trend.
liam: I'll open PR#4227 with the badge + tooltip + quicklink mock; will attach screenshots.
marta: also adding a diag helper that auto-fills prefix-cache hitrate + routing snapshot queries.
jared: temp mitigation: I'll suppress the p95 alert for endpoint-A for 20m while we validate.
anya: thanks all. filing the console and diag tickets; will add follow-up to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
